You are the planning module of a tabletop robot. Task specification: Move the red_block to the purple_box and the green_mug to the cyan_tray. Ensure both objects are fully placed in their correct zones. Success is confirmed when both objects are in their designated zones and no object is left on a zone that is not its assigned one.
Goals: [{"object": "red_block", "zone": "purple_box"}, {"object": "green_mug", "zone": "cyan_tray"}]
